from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import re
from collections import deque
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit

from .contracts import RECORD_TYPES, Observation, SubmissionState
from .evidence import EvidenceLedger
from .models import normalize_record_item
from .pricing import calculate
from .prompts import SYSTEM
from .submit import Submission
from .telemetry import safe_error


def action_signature(action, observation):
    """Detect unchanged retries without conflating identically labelled rows or pagination."""
    args = dict(action.args)
    if "ref" in args:
        control = next((x for x in observation.controls if x["ref"] == args["ref"]), {})
        args["ref"] = (re.sub(r"^(?:.*-)?o\d+-", "", args["ref"]), control.get("label"), control.get("context"))
    state = (observation.url, hashlib.sha256(observation.text.encode()).hexdigest())
    return action.action, json.dumps(args, sort_keys=True, default=str), state


class Orchestrator:
    def __init__(self, run, config, browser, model, telemetry, deadline, token=None, *, ledger=None,
                 submission=None, agent_name="orchestrator", role_instruction="", research_only=False):
        self.run, self.config, self.browser, self.model = run, config, browser, model
        self.telemetry, self.deadline, self.token = telemetry, deadline, token
        self.ledger = ledger or EvidenceLedger(telemetry)
        self.submission = submission or Submission(run, browser, telemetry)
        self.agent_name, self.role_instruction, self.research_only = agent_name, role_instruction, research_only
        # A full RFQ run has a protected signing window.  MultiAgentCoordinator
        # enables this only for its pre-submission research phase; an explicit
        # research-only rehearsal can still use all of its requested budget.
        self.stop_at_submission_reserve = False
        self.history = deque(maxlen=16)
        self.pricing = None
        self.observation = None
        self.stage = "investigating"
        self.last_action = None
        self.repeat_count = 0
        self._warned = False
        self.tan_callback = None
        self.popup_classifier = None
        self.popup_classification = None

    def messages(self):
        context = {
            "task": self.telemetry.redactor.text(self.run.brief),
            "sites": [{"id": s.siteId, "url": s.url,
                       "credential_handles": [f"{s.siteId}:{key}" for key in s.credentials]} for s in self.run.access],
            "submission_target": self.run.submission.model_dump(), "answer_schema": self.run.answer_schema,
            "remaining_seconds": round(self.deadline.remaining), "reserve_seconds": self.deadline.reserve,
            "submission_due": self.deadline.submission_due, "stage": self.stage,
            "submission_state": self.submission.state, "evidence_ledger": self.ledger.model_context(),
            "calculation": self.pricing.model_dump(mode="json") if self.pricing else None,
            "recent_actions_and_results": list(self.history),
            "current_observation": self.observation.model_dump(mode="json") if self.observation else None,
            "agent": self.agent_name,
            "role_instruction": self.role_instruction,
            "research_only": self.research_only,
            "popup_classification": self.popup_classification,
        }
        content = [{"type": "text", "text": json.dumps(self.telemetry.redactor.clean(context), ensure_ascii=False, default=str)}]
        if self.browser.last_image:
            content.append({"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/png;base64," + self.browser.last_image}})
        return [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, {"role": "user", "content": content}]

    async def run_loop(self, max_steps=450):
        task_obs = Observation(id="task", action_id=0, tab=0, url="runtime:brief", title="Runtime task brief",
                               text=self.telemetry.redactor.text(self.run.brief))
        self.ledger.observe(task_obs)
        self.telemetry.emit("stage_changed", stage=self.stage, remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
        consecutive_errors = 0
        for step in range(1, max_steps + 1):
            if self.research_only and self.stop_at_submission_reserve and self.deadline.submission_due:
                self.telemetry.emit("agent_complete", agent=self.agent_name,
                                    reason="submission reserve reached", remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
                return True
            if self.deadline.remaining <= 1:
                break
            if self.submission.state in {SubmissionState.ACCEPTED, SubmissionState.SCOUTING_ACKNOWLEDGED}:
                return True
            self.telemetry.action_id = step
            if self.deadline.submission_due and not self._warned:
                self._warned = True
                self.stage = "submitting"
                self.pricing = calculate(self.ledger, allow_partial=True)
                self.telemetry.emit("deadline_warning", remaining=self.deadline.remaining,
                                    message="Research reserve exhausted: prioritize verified partial signing")
                self.telemetry.emit("stage_changed", stage=self.stage, remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
            try:
                if self.observation is None:
                    self.observation = await asyncio.wait_for(self.browser.observe(), self.deadline.timeout(25))
                    self.ledger.observe(self.observation)
                    self.popup_classification = await self._classify_popup(self.observation)
                if self.popup_classification and self.popup_classification.get("kind") == "verification_gate":
                    if self.stage != "solving_verification":
                        self.stage = "solving_verification"
                        self.telemetry.emit("stage_changed", stage=self.stage, remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
                    self.telemetry.emit("verification_gate_detected", observation=self.observation.id,
                                        reason=self.popup_classification.get("reason", ""))
                    # Do not skip: the model solves the observed gate with
                    # drag + check + fill + click (see SYSTEM guidance).
                action = await self.model.decide(self.messages(), self.deadline)
                self.telemetry.emit("model_decision", **action.model_dump(), remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
                signature = action_signature(action, self.observation)
                self.repeat_count = self.repeat_count + 1 if signature == self.last_action else 0
                self.last_action = signature
                if self.repeat_count >= 3:
                    raise ValueError("Repeated action made no progress. Inspect current state and choose a different action.")
                self.telemetry.emit("tool_call", tool=action.action, arguments=action.args)
                result = await asyncio.wait_for(self.execute(action), self.deadline.timeout(35))
                self.telemetry.emit("tool_result", tool=action.action, result=result)
                self.history.append({"action": action.model_dump(), "result": result})
                consecutive_errors = 0
            except Exception as exc:
                error = safe_error(exc, self.telemetry.redactor)
                self.telemetry.emit("tool_error", error=error, remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
                self.history.append({"error": error, "instruction": "Correct malformed arguments or inspect the current page. Do not repeat a failed path blindly."})
                self.observation = None
                consecutive_errors += 1
                if consecutive_errors >= 8:
                    self.telemetry.emit("run_failed", reason="Eight consecutive model/tool failures")
                    return False
            finally:
                self.telemetry.artifact("evidence.json", self.ledger.summary())
        if self.research_only:
            self.telemetry.emit("agent_complete", agent=self.agent_name, reason="research step budget reached",
                                remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
            return True
        self.telemetry.emit("run_failed", reason="Deadline or step limit reached without verified signed receipt",
                            submission=self.submission.state.value, remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
        return False

    async def _classify_popup(self, observation):
        if not self.popup_classifier:
            return None
        return await self.popup_classifier.classify(self.browser.last_image, observation)

    async def execute(self, action):
        name, args = action.action, action.args
        if self.research_only and self._targets_submission(name, args):
            raise ValueError("Evidence-only mode cannot enter the declared submission path")
        if self.research_only and name in {"calculate", "prepare_submission", "fill_answer", "request_tan",
                                           "capture_tan", "sign", "receipt", "api_submit"}:
            raise ValueError("This specialist publishes evidence only; the central orchestrator owns pricing and signing")
        if name in {"click", "fill", "select", "check", "press", "drag"} and self.observation:
            control = next((item for item in self.observation.controls if item["ref"] == args.get("ref")), None)
            if control and control.get("blocked_by_modal"):
                modal_labels = [str(item.get("label") or "control") for item in self.observation.controls
                                if item.get("inside_modal")]
                choices = ", ".join(modal_labels[:6]) or "an observed inside-modal control"
                raise ValueError(f"Selected control is blocked by a modal; choose: {choices}")
        if name == "read_links":
            results = []
            try:
                async for observation, result in self.browser.read_links(args["refs"]):
                    self.ledger.observe(observation)
                    results.append(result)
            finally:
                self.observation = await self.browser.observe()
                self.ledger.observe(self.observation)
            return results
        if name == "inspect_controls":
            results = []
            try:
                async for observation, result in self.browser.inspect_controls(args["refs"]):
                    self.observation = observation
                    self.ledger.observe(observation)
                    results.append(result.model_dump(mode="json"))
            except (ValueError, TimeoutError) as exc:
                results.append({"error": safe_error(exc, self.telemetry.redactor)})
            return results
        if name == "schema":
        elif name == "request_tan":
            result = await self.submission.request_tan(args)
            if self.tan_callback:
                await self.tan_callback(self.submission)
        elif name == "sign":
            result = await self.submission.sign(args)
        elif name == "capture_tan":
            if not self.submission.result:
                raise ValueError("No prepared tender for TAN matching")
            observation = self.ledger.observations[args["observation"]]
            if self.submission.result.answer["tender_reference"] not in observation.text:
                raise ValueError("Signing mail must visibly identify this exact tender")
            result = await self.browser.act(name, args)
            if self.browser is not self.submission.browser and self.browser.latest_tan:
                self.submission.browser.latest_tan = self.browser.latest_tan
                self.submission.browser.tan_captured_at = self.browser.tan_captured_at
        else:
            result = await self.browser.act(name, args)
        self.observation = await self.browser.observe(include_image=name == "screenshot")
        self.ledger.observe(self.observation)
        self.popup_classification = await self._classify_popup(self.observation)
        return result

    def _targets_submission(self, name, args) -> bool:
        """Keep an evidence-only pass away from the runtime-declared bid path."""
        target = self.run.submission.url.rstrip("/")
        if name == "navigate":
            candidate = urljoin(self.observation.url, str(args.get("url", ""))).rstrip("/")
            # Some site submissions declare only the portal origin.  That
            # origin is also needed to log in and investigate, so only a
            # declared non-root path is an exact block; otherwise use generic
            # submission semantics in the observed destination.
            return self._submission_url(candidate, target)
        if name != "click" or not self.observation:
            return False
        control = next((item for item in self.observation.controls if item["ref"] == args.get("ref")), None)
        if not control:
            return False
        candidate = urljoin(self.observation.url, control.get("href") or "").rstrip("/")
        visible = " ".join(str(control.get(key) or "") for key in ("label", "context")).casefold()
        return self._submission_url(candidate, target) or bool(re.search(r"\b(?:submit|submission|offer|bid|angebot|abgabe)\b", visible))

    @staticmethod
    def _submission_url(candidate: str, target: str) -> bool:
        target_path = re.sub(r"/+", "/", urlsplit(target).path).rstrip("/")
        candidate_path = re.sub(r"/+", "/", urlsplit(candidate).path).rstrip("/")
        if target_path:
            return candidate.startswith(target)
        return bool(re.search(r"/(?:submit|submission|offer|bid|angebot|abgabe)(?:/|$)", candidate_path, re.I))

        if name == "read_links":
            results = []

                    self.ledger.observe(observation)
                    results.append(result)
            finally:

        if name == "inspect_controls":

        """Keep an evidence-only pass away from the runtime-declared bid path."""
        target = self.run.submission.url.rstrip("/")

            candidate = urljoin(self.observation.url, str(args.get("url", ""))).rstrip("/")

        self.assignments = assign_sites(run.access)
        self.ledger = EvidenceLedger(root_telemetry)
        self.specialists: dict[str, Specialist] = {}
        self.submission = None
        self.pricing = None
        self.sequential_fallback = False

    @property
    def telemetries(self):
        return [self.root_telemetry, *(item.telemetry for item in self.specialists.values())]

    async def start(self):
        if self.config.sandbox and len(self.config.cdp_urls) != 4:
            raise RuntimeError("The multi-agent runtime requires exactly four supplied CDP browsers")
        if len(self.run.access) < 4:
            raise RuntimeError("The RFQ runtime must provide four website access records")
        dispatcher = QwenClient(self.config, self.root_telemetry)
        try:
            self.assignments = await dispatcher.assign_specialists(
                self.run.brief, [{"id": site.siteId, "url": site.url} for site in self.run.access], self.assignments)
        finally:
            await dispatcher.close()
        for index, role in enumerate(ROLE_ORDER):
            site_id = self.assignments[role]
            telemetry = Telemetry(self.trace_dir / role, self.root_telemetry.redactor, run_id=self.run.run_id,
                                  console=self.root_telemetry.console, agent=role)
            telemetry.structured_stdout = self.root_telemetry.structured_stdout
            telemetry.debug = self.root_telemetry.debug
            browser = BrowserSession(self.config, self.run, telemetry, headful=True, browser_index=index,
                                     agent_id=role, assigned_site=site_id, allow_submission=role == "tender")
            await browser.start()
            model = QwenClient(self.config, telemetry)
            classifier = PopupClassifier(self.config, telemetry)
            controller = Orchestrator(self.run, self.config, browser, model, telemetry, self.deadline, self.token,
                                      ledger=self.ledger, agent_name=role, role_instruction=ROLE_INSTRUCTIONS[role],
                                      research_only=True)
            controller.popup_classifier = classifier
            self.specialists[role] = Specialist(role, site_id, browser, model, classifier, telemetry, controller)
            telemetry.emit("agent_started", role=role, assigned_site=site_id, browser_index=index,
                           remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
        tender = self.specialists["tender"]
        self.submission = Submission(self.run, tender.browser, tender.telemetry)

    async def investigate(self, steps=72, *, stop_at_submission_reserve=False):
        return await self.investigate_roles(steps=steps, stop_at_submission_reserve=stop_at_submission_reserve)

    async def investigate_roles(self, *, steps=72, roles: tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
                                stop_at_submission_reserve=False):
        """Run all specialists or a bounded evidence-only focus subset."""
        selected = tuple(roles or tuple(self.specialists))
        unknown = set(selected) - set(self.specialists)
        if unknown:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown specialist roles: {sorted(unknown)}")
        async def run_one(item: Specialist):
            item.controller.stop_at_submission_reserve = stop_at_submission_reserve
            try:

summary.text: **Fixing navigation error handling and fallback bugs**

content.text:
Yes. I added a 40-second `about:blank` watchdog that navigates the assigned browser back to its runtime-supplied base URL. It deliberately does not reload `about:blank` itself; it interrupts the stalled load with a safe site-level navigation, gives it 15 seconds, and rate-limits further attempts to once per 40 seconds. See [browser.py](/C:/Users/alvar/Desktop/EHL_Finale/src/atira_agent/browser.py:284).

What the downloaded log proves:

- It starts at elapsed ~684 seconds, so it cannot confirm the original startup incident.
- The final failure was the Tender browser, not Mail: `tender-o9` through `tender-o14` stayed `about:blank`, titled “Loading [tender portal]”.
- Each blank observation was followed by a ~25-second model timeout; there were no final Tender decisions or submission actions.
- Specifications failed after eight consecutive errors. Tender was also failed by the time coordination finished.
- At the signing reserve, only ERP and Mail had completed. Pricing then correctly refused to invent an offer: `Need one tender record`.
- No `fill_answer`, TAN request/capture, signing, or receipt-verification event occurred.

I fixed two other direct causes:

- The live `record` tool advertised an obsolete batch shape while also requiring `kind` + `data`; that produced the repeated “record requires data” failures. It now exposes one unambiguous record envelope in [tool_specs.py](/C:/Users/alvar/Desktop/EHL_Finale/src/atira_agent/tool_specs.py:32) and [prompts.py](/C:/Users/alvar/Desktop/EHL_Finale/src/atira_agent/prompts.py:49).
- The sequential recovery path was only considered after every specialist stopped—which was too late because ERP/Mail ran until the submission reserve. It now starts as soon as the second specialist fails, while slower healthy workers continue: [multi_agent.py](/C:/Users/alvar/Desktop/EHL_Finale/src/atira_agent/multi_agent.py:138).

One remaining environmental signal: three model responses were malformed/empty; two consumed all 1,200 completion tokens as reasoning with no visible tool call. That is distinct from the blank-page fault and may warrant a separate Qwen response-budget tuning pass if it recurs.

Validation passed: `ruff`, whitespace validation, and 56 focused tests—including new blank-tab and early-recovery tests. I have not claimed a successful receipt yet; the next official run is needed to validate these changes end-to-end.

It now exposes one unambiguous record envelope in [tool_specs.py](/C:/Users/alvar/Desktop/EHL_Finale/src/atira_agent/tool_specs.py:32) and [prompts.py](/C:/Users/alvar/Desktop/EHL_Finale/src/atira_agent/prompts.py:49).
- The sequential recovery path was only considered after every specialist stopped—which was too late because ERP/Mail ran until the submission reserve. It now starts as soon as the second specialist fails, while slower healthy workers continue: [multi_agent.py](/C:/Users/alvar/Desktop/EHL_Finale/src/atira_agent/multi_agent.py:138).

One remaining environmental signal: three model responses were malformed/empty; two consumed all 1,200 completion tokens as reasoning with no visible tool call. That is distinct from the blank-page fault and may warrant a separate Qwen response-budget tuning pass if it recurs.

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import re
from collections import deque
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit

from .contracts import RECORD_TYPES, Observation, SubmissionState
from .evidence import EvidenceLedger
from .models import normalize_record_item
from .pricing import calculate
from .prompts import SYSTEM
from .submit import Submission
from .telemetry import safe_error


def action_signature(action, observation):
    """Detect unchanged retries without conflating identically labelled rows or pagination."""
    args = dict(action.args)
    if "ref" in args:
        control = next((x for x in observation.controls if x["ref"] == args["ref"]), {})
        args["ref"] = (re.sub(r"^(?:.*-)?o\d+-", "", args["ref"]), control.get("label"), control.get("context"))
    state = (observation.url, hashlib.sha256(observation.text.encode()).hexdigest())
    return action.action, json.dumps(args, sort_keys=True, default=str), state


class Orchestrator:
    def __init__(self, run, config, browser, model, telemetry, deadline, token=None, *, ledger=None,
                 submission=None, agent_name="orchestrator", role_instruction="", research_only=False):
        self.run, self.config, self.browser, self.model = run, config, browser, model
        self.telemetry, self.deadline, self.token = telemetry, deadline, token
        self.ledger = ledger or EvidenceLedger(telemetry)
        self.submission = submission or Submission(run, browser, telemetry)
        self.agent_name, self.role_instruction, self.research_only = agent_name, role_instruction, research_only
        # A full RFQ run has a protected signing window.  MultiAgentCoordinator
        # enables this only for its pre-submission research phase; an explicit
        # research-only rehearsal can still use all of its requested budget.
        self.stop_at_submission_reserve = False
        self.history = deque(maxlen=16)
        self.pricing = None
        self.observation = None
        self.stage = "investigating"
        self.last_action = None
        self.repeat_count = 0
        self._warned = False
        self.tan_callback = None
        self.popup_classifier = None
        self.popup_classification = None

    def messages(self):
        context = {
            "task": self.telemetry.redactor.text(self.run.brief),
            "sites": [{"id": s.siteId, "url": s.url,
                       "credential_handles": [f"{s.siteId}:{key}" for key in s.credentials]} for s in self.run.access],
            "submission_target": self.run.submission.model_dump(), "answer_schema": self.run.answer_schema,
            "remaining_seconds": round(self.deadline.remaining), "reserve_seconds": self.deadline.reserve,
            "submission_due": self.deadline.submission_due, "stage": self.stage,
            "submission_state": self.submission.state, "evidence_ledger": self.ledger.model_context(),
            "calculation": self.pricing.model_dump(mode="json") if self.pricing else None,
            "recent_actions_and_results": list(self.history),
            "current_observation": self.observation.model_dump(mode="json") if self.observation else None,
            "agent": self.agent_name,
            "role_instruction": self.role_instruction,
            "research_only": self.research_only,
            "popup_classification": self.popup_classification,
        }
        content = [{"type": "text", "text": json.dumps(self.telemetry.redactor.clean(context), ensure_ascii=False, default=str)}]
        if self.browser.last_image:
            content.append({"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/png;base64," + self.browser.last_image}})
        return [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, {"role": "user", "content": content}]

    async def run_loop(self, max_steps=450):
        task_obs = Observation(id="task", action_id=0, tab=0, url="runtime:brief", title="Runtime task brief",
                               text=self.telemetry.redactor.text(self.run.brief))
        self.ledger.observe(task_obs)
        self.telemetry.emit("stage_changed", stage=self.stage, remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
        consecutive_errors = 0
        for step in range(1, max_steps + 1):
            if self.research_only and self.stop_at_submission_reserve and self.deadline.submission_due:
                self.telemetry.emit("agent_complete", agent=self.agent_name,
                                    reason="submission reserve reached", remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
                return True
            if self.deadline.remaining <= 1:
                break
            if self.submission.state in {SubmissionState.ACCEPTED, SubmissionState.SCOUTING_ACKNOWLEDGED}:
                return True
            self.telemetry.action_id = step
            if self.deadline.submission_due and not self._warned:
                self._warned = True
                self.stage = "submitting"
                self.pricing = calculate(self.ledger, allow_partial=True)
                self.telemetry.emit("deadline_warning", remaining=self.deadline.remaining,
                                    message="Research reserve exhausted: prioritize verified partial signing")
                self.telemetry.emit("stage_changed", stage=self.stage, remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
            try:
                if self.observation is None:
                    self.observation = await asyncio.wait_for(self.browser.observe(), self.deadline.timeout(25))
                    self.ledger.observe(self.observation)
                    self.popup_classification = await self._classify_popup(self.observation)
                if self.popup_classification and self.popup_classification.get("kind") == "verification_gate":
                    if self.stage != "solving_verification":
                        self.stage = "solving_verification"
                        self.telemetry.emit("stage_changed", stage=self.stage, remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
                    self.telemetry.emit("verification_gate_detected", observation=self.observation.id,
                                        reason=self.popup_classification.get("reason", ""))
                    # Do not skip: the model solves the observed gate with
                    # drag + check + fill + click (see SYSTEM guidance).
                action = await self.model.decide(self.messages(), self.deadline)
                self.telemetry.emit("model_decision", **action.model_dump(), remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
                signature = action_signature(action, self.observation)
                self.repeat_count = self.repeat_count + 1 if signature == self.last_action else 0
                self.last_action = signature
                if self.repeat_count >= 3:
                    raise ValueError("Repeated action made no progress. Inspect current state and choose a different action.")
                self.telemetry.emit("tool_call", tool=action.action, arguments=action.args)
                result = await asyncio.wait_for(self.execute(action), self.deadline.timeout(35))
                self.telemetry.emit("tool_result", tool=action.action, result=result)
                self.history.append({"action": action.model_dump(), "result": result})
                consecutive_errors = 0
            except Exception as exc:
                error = safe_error(exc, self.telemetry.redactor)
                self.telemetry.emit("tool_error", error=error, remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
                self.history.append({"error": error, "instruction": "Correct malformed arguments or inspect the current page. Do not repeat a failed path blindly."})
                status = getattr(exc, "status_code", None)
                self.telemetry.emit("model_error", error=type(exc).__name__, status=status, attempt=attempt + 1)
                if status is not None and status not in {408, 429} and status < 500:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"Model request rejected: HTTP {status}") from None
                if attempt == 2 or deadline.remaining < 10:
                    raise
                await asyncio.sleep(min(2 ** attempt + random.random(), max(0, deadline.remaining - 1)))

    async def smoke(self):
        response = await self.client.chat.completions.create(model=self.config.model, timeout=360,
            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Reply with exactly READY."}], max_tokens=300)
        if not response.choices[0].message.content:
            raise RuntimeError("Model smoke returned no visible answer")
        return {"model": self.config.model, "reply": response.choices[0].message.content,
                "usage": response.usage.model_dump() if response.usage else None}

    async def assign_specialists(self, brief: str, sites: list[dict], fallback: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Use Qwen to assign opaque runtime sites to the four fixed responsibilities.

        The result is validated against the runtime inventory and falls back to a
        deterministic mapping if the small dispatch call is unavailable.
        """
        prompt = {"task": "Assign the four supplied websites to tender, specifications, erp and mail specialists.",
                  "brief": self.telemetry.redactor.text(brief), "sites": sites,
                  "return": {"tender": "siteId", "specifications": "siteId", "erp": "siteId", "mail": "siteId"}}
        try:
            reply = await self.client.chat.completions.create(
                model=self.config.model, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": json.dumps(prompt, ensure_ascii=False)}],
                response_format={"type": "json_object"}, temperature=0, max_tokens=300,
            )
            value = json.loads((reply.choices[0].message.content or "{}"))
            valid = {site["id"] for site in sites}
            if set(value) != set(fallback) or set(value.values()) != valid:
                raise ValueError("invalid assignment")
            self.telemetry.emit("specialist_dispatch", assignments=value, method="qwen")
            return value
        except Exception as exc:
            self.telemetry.emit("specialist_dispatch", assignments=fallback, method="validated_fallback",
                                error=type(exc).__name__)
            return fallback

    async def close(self):
        await self.client.close()

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import re
from collections import deque
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit

from .contracts import RECORD_TYPES, Observation, SubmissionState
from .evidence import EvidenceLedger
from .models import normalize_record_item
from .pricing import calculate
from .prompts import SYSTEM
from .submit import Submission
from .telemetry import safe_error


def action_signature(action, observation):
    """Detect unchanged retries without conflating identically labelled rows or pagination."""
    args = dict(action.args)
    if "ref" in args:
        control = next((x for x in observation.controls if x["ref"] == args["ref"]), {})
        args["ref"] = (re.sub(r"^(?:.*-)?o\d+-", "", args["ref"]), control.get("label"), control.get("context"))
    state = (observation.url, hashlib.sha256(observation.text.encode()).hexdigest())
    return action.action, json.dumps(args, sort_keys=True, default=str), state


class Orchestrator:
    def __init__(self, run, config, browser, model, telemetry, deadline, token=None, *, ledger=None,
                 submission=None, agent_name="orchestrator", role_instruction="", research_only=False):
        self.run, self.config, self.browser, self.model = run, config, browser, model
        self.telemetry, self.deadline, self.token = telemetry, deadline, token
        self.ledger = ledger or EvidenceLedger(telemetry)
        self.submission = submission or Submission(run, browser, telemetry)
        self.agent_name, self.role_instruction, self.research_only = agent_name, role_instruction, research_only
        # A full RFQ run has a protected signing window.  MultiAgentCoordinator
        # enables this only for its pre-submission research phase; an explicit
        # research-only rehearsal can still use all of its requested budget.
        self.stop_at_submission_reserve = False
        self.history = deque(maxlen=16)
        self.pricing = None
        self.observation = None
        self.stage = "investigating"
        self.last_action = None
        self.repeat_count = 0
        self._warned = False
        self.tan_callback = None
        self.popup_classifier = None
        self.popup_classification = None

    def messages(self):
        context = {
            "task": self.telemetry.redactor.text(self.run.brief),
            "sites": [{"id": s.siteId, "url": s.url,
                       "credential_handles": [f"{s.siteId}:{key}" for key in s.credentials]} for s in self.run.access],
            "submission_target": self.run.submission.model_dump(), "answer_schema": self.run.answer_schema,
            "remaining_seconds": round(self.deadline.remaining), "reserve_seconds": self.deadline.reserve,
            "submission_due": self.deadline.submission_due, "stage": self.stage,
            "submission_state": self.submission.state, "evidence_ledger": self.ledger.model_context(),
            "calculation": self.pricing.model_dump(mode="json") if self.pricing else None,
            "recent_actions_and_results": list(self.history),
            "current_observation": self.observation.model_dump(mode="json") if self.observation else None,
            "agent": self.agent_name,
            "role_instruction": self.role_instruction,
            "research_only": self.research_only,
            "popup_classification": self.popup_classification,
        }
        content = [{"type": "text", "text": json.dumps(self.telemetry.redactor.clean(context), ensure_ascii=False, default=str)}]
        if self.browser.last_image:
            content.append({"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/png;base64," + self.browser.last_image}})
        return [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, {"role": "user", "content": content}]

    async def run_loop(self, max_steps=450):
        task_obs = Observation(id="task", action_id=0, tab=0, url="runtime:brief", title="Runtime task brief",
                               text=self.telemetry.redactor.text(self.run.brief))
        self.ledger.observe(task_obs)
        self.telemetry.emit("stage_changed", stage=self.stage, remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
        consecutive_errors = 0
        for step in range(1, max_steps + 1):
            if self.research_only and self.stop_at_submission_reserve and self.deadline.submission_due:
                self.telemetry.emit("agent_complete", agent=self.agent_name,
                                    reason="submission reserve reached", remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
                return True
            if self.deadline.remaining <= 1:
                break
            if self.submission.state in {SubmissionState.ACCEPTED, SubmissionState.SCOUTING_ACKNOWLEDGED}:
                return True
            self.telemetry.action_id = step
            if self.deadline.submission_due and not self._warned:
                self._warned = True
                self.stage = "submitting"
                self.pricing = calculate(self.ledger, allow_partial=True)
                self.telemetry.emit("deadline_warning", remaining=self.deadline.remaining,
                                    message="Research reserve exhausted: prioritize verified partial signing")
                self.telemetry.emit("stage_changed", stage=self.stage, remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
            try:
                if self.observation is None:
                    self.observation = await asyncio.wait_for(self.browser.observe(), self.deadline.timeout(25))
                    self.ledger.observe(self.observation)
                    self.popup_classification = await self._classify_popup(self.observation)
                if self.popup_classification and self.popup_classification.get("kind") == "verification_gate":
                    if self.stage != "solving_verification":
                        self.stage = "solving_verification"
                        self.telemetry.emit("stage_changed", stage=self.stage, remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
                    self.telemetry.emit("verification_gate_detected", observation=self.observation.id,
                                        reason=self.popup_classification.get("reason", ""))
                    # Do not skip: the model solves the observed gate with
                    # drag + check + fill + click (see SYSTEM guidance).
                action = await self.model.decide(self.messages(), self.deadline)
                self.telemetry.emit("model_decision", **action.model_dump(), remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
                signature = action_signature(action, self.observation)
                self.repeat_count = self.repeat_count + 1 if signature == self.last_action else 0
                self.last_action = signature
                if self.repeat_count >= 3:
                    raise ValueError("Repeated action made no progress. Inspect current state and choose a different action.")
                self.telemetry.emit("tool_call", tool=action.action, arguments=action.args)
                result = await asyncio.wait_for(self.execute(action), self.deadline.timeout(35))
                self.telemetry.emit("tool_result", tool=action.action, result=result)
                self.history.append({"action": action.model_dump(), "result": result})
                consecutive_errors = 0
            except Exception as exc:
                error = safe_error(exc, self.telemetry.redactor)
                self.telemetry.emit("tool_error", error=error, remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
                self.history.append({"error": error, "instruction": "Correct malformed arguments or inspect the current page. Do not repeat a failed path blindly."})
                status = getattr(exc, "status_code", None)
                self.telemetry.emit("model_error", error=type(exc).__name__, status=status, attempt=attempt + 1)
                if status is not None and status not in {408, 429} and status < 500:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"Model request rejected: HTTP {status}") from None
                if attempt == 2 or deadline.remaining < 10:
                    raise
                await asyncio.sleep(min(2 ** attempt + random.random(), max(0, deadline.remaining - 1)))

    async def smoke(self):
        response = await self.client.chat.completions.create(model=self.config.model, timeout=360,
            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Reply with exactly READY."}], max_tokens=300)
        if not response.choices[0].message.content:
            raise RuntimeError("Model smoke returned no visible answer")
        return {"model": self.config.model, "reply": response.choices[0].message.content,
                "usage": response.usage.model_dump() if response.usage else None}

    async def assign_specialists(self, brief: str, sites: list[dict], fallback: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Use Qwen to assign opaque runtime sites to the four fixed responsibilities.

        The result is validated against the runtime inventory and falls back to a
        deterministic mapping if the small dispatch call is unavailable.
        """
        prompt = {"task": "Assign the four supplied websites to tender, specifications, erp and mail specialists.",
                  "brief": self.telemetry.redactor.text(brief), "sites": sites,
                  "return": {"tender": "siteId", "specifications": "siteId", "erp": "siteId", "mail": "siteId"}}
        try:
            reply = await self.client.chat.completions.create(
                model=self.config.model, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": json.dumps(prompt, ensure_ascii=False)}],
                response_format={"type": "json_object"}, temperature=0, max_tokens=300,
            )
            value = json.loads((reply.choices[0].message.content or "{}"))
            valid = {site["id"] for site in sites}
            if set(value) != set(fallback) or set(value.values()) != valid:
                raise ValueError("invalid assignment")
            self.telemetry.emit("specialist_dispatch", assignments=value, method="qwen")
            return value
        except Exception as exc:
            self.telemetry.emit("specialist_dispatch", assignments=fallback, method="validated_fallback",
                                error=type(exc).__name__)
            return fallback

    async def close(self):
        await self.client.close()

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections import defaultdict

from .contracts import RECORD_TYPES, EvidenceFact, Observation, Sourced


def compact(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()


class EvidenceLedger:
    def __init__(self, telemetry):
        self.telemetry = telemetry
        self.observations: dict[str, Observation] = {}
        self.facts: dict[str, EvidenceFact] = {}
        self.records: dict[str, dict[str, Sourced]] = defaultdict(dict)
        self.rejected: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = {}
        self.conflicts: list[dict] = []

    def reject(self, kind: str, data: dict, error: str):
        key = (kind, str(data.get("id", "missing-id")))
        self.rejected[key] = {"kind": kind, "data": data, "error": error}
        if len(self.rejected) > 50:
            self.rejected.pop(next(iter(self.rejected)))

    def observe(self, observation: Observation) -> None:
        self.observations[observation.id] = observation

    def cite(self, observation_id: str, excerpt: str, scope: dict | None = None) -> EvidenceFact:
        # A control reference unambiguously identifies its originating observation. Accept that spelling,
        # but still require the exact excerpt to exist in that observation's visible text.
        control = re.fullmatch(r"(.+)-f\d+-e\d+", observation_id)
        if control:
            observation_id = control.group(1)
        if observation_id not in self.observations:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown observation {observation_id!r}; use current_observation.id, not an element ref")
        observation = self.observations[observation_id]
        if len(compact(excerpt)) < 3 or compact(excerpt) not in compact(observation.text):
            raise ValueError("Citation must be an exact visible excerpt from the named observation")
        fact = EvidenceFact(
            id=f"e{len(self.facts) + 1}", observation_id=observation_id, website=observation.url,
            url=observation.url, title=observation.title, excerpt=excerpt, action_id=observation.action_id,
            observed_at=observation.observed_at, scope=scope or {},
        )
        self.facts[fact.id] = fact
        self.telemetry.emit("evidence_added", evidence=fact.model_dump(mode="json"))
        return fact

    def record(self, kind: str, data: dict) -> Sourced:
        if kind not in RECORD_TYPES:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown record kind: {kind}")
        record = RECORD_TYPES[kind].model_validate(data)
        missing = [ref for ref in record.evidence if ref not in self.facts]
        if missing:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown evidence references: {missing}")
        old = self.records[kind].get(record.id)
        if old and old != record:
            self.conflicts.append({"kind": kind, "id": record.id, "previous": old.model_dump(mode="json"),
                                   "replacement": record.model_dump(mode="json")})
            self.telemetry.emit("conflict_detected", kind=kind, record_id=record.id,
                                previous=old.model_dump(mode="json"), replacement=record.model_dump(mode="json"))
        self.records[kind][record.id] = record
        self.rejected.pop((kind, record.id), None)
        self.telemetry.emit("record_added", kind=kind, record=record.model_dump(mode="json"))
        return record

    def all(self, kind: str) -> list:
        return list(self.records[kind].values())

    def snapshot(self) -> dict:
        return {kind: [v.model_dump(mode="json") for v in values.values()] for kind, values in self.records.items() if values}

    def summary(self) -> dict:
        return {"records": self.snapshot(), "rejected_records": list(self.rejected.values()),
                "extraction_replacements": self.conflicts[-20:], "evidence": [
            {"id": v.id, "scope": v.scope, "excerpt": v.excerpt[:120]} for v in self.facts.values()
        ]}

    def model_context(self, *, max_evidence: int = 24) -> dict:
        """Return the bounded shared context needed for the next model action.

        Durable artifacts retain the complete ledger.  A page-level decision
        needs cited records and a small recent fact index, not every historic
        excerpt.  Bounding this avoids turning a long Q&A investigation into a
        slow cross-agent prompt while preserving `inspect_evidence` for any
        older observation.
        """
        return {
            "records": self.snapshot(),
            "rejected_records": list(self.rejected.values())[-12:],
            "extraction_replacements": self.conflicts[-8:],
            "evidence": [
                {"id": v.id, "scope": v.scope, "excerpt": v.excerpt[:120]}
                for v in list(self.facts.values())[-max_evidence:]
            ],
        }
"""Dependency-aware four-browser RFQ coordination.

The coordinator is deliberately browserless.  Specialists only publish cited
records to a shared ledger; deterministic pricing and the binding submission
remain centrally owned.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from .browser import BrowserSession
from .evidence import EvidenceLedger
from .models import QwenClient
from .orchestrator import Orchestrator
from .popup_classifier import PopupClassifier
from .pricing import calculate
from .submit import Submission
from .telemetry import Telemetry, safe_error

ROLE_ORDER = ("tender", "specifications", "erp", "mail")
ROLE_HINTS = {
    "tender": ("tender", "award", "bid", "vergabe", "rfq"),
    "specifications": ("spec", "customer", "document", "drawing", "requirement"),
    "erp": ("erp", "sap", "material", "inventory", "catalog"),
    "mail": ("mail", "inbox", "email", "postfach", "archive"),
}
ROLE_INSTRUCTIONS = {
    "tender": "Own only the assigned tender portal. Resolve the tender reference, positions, current Q&A, amendments, keys and deadline. After identifying the tender, finish the model-selected Q&A pages: expand relevant answers, reveal each issued date, follow pagination, and record withdrawals/amendments before spending turns on optional documents. Publish cited tender, position and Q&A records. Do not calculate or submit during investigation.",
    "specifications": "Own only the assigned specification/customer portal. Resolve the current revision, complete requirements, engineering attributes, certification and governing units. Publish cited revision and requirement records. Wait for tender/Q&A facts when scope is ambiguous.",
    "erp": "Own only the assigned ERP portal. First learn safe search/navigation, then use published requirements to select exact active materials and publish cited material, search and price records. Never infer a missing match from an incomplete search.",
    "mail": "Own only the assigned mailbox. First learn inbox/archive access. Once the tender reference is published, find authorized dated messages and publish cited approval, FX, index, packaging, pool, bonus, commercial, technical and commitment records. TANs remain secret.",
}


def assign_sites(access) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Map runtime-provided sites to specialist roles without scenario-specific URLs.

    Runtime IDs and hosts are only hints.  If an unseen deployment gives opaque
    identifiers, assignment remains deterministic and every specialist still
    decides its own navigation from live observations.
    """
    available = list(access)
    result: dict[str, str] = {}
    for role in ROLE_ORDER:
        best = None
        best_score = 0
        for site in available:
            text = f"{site.siteId} {site.url}".lower()
            score = sum(bool(re.search(re.escape(hint), text)) for hint in ROLE_HINTS[role])
            if score > best_score:
                best, best_score = site, score
        if best is None:
            best = available[0]
        result[role] = best.siteId
        available.remove(best)
    return result


def benchmark_schedule() -> dict:
    """Deterministic scheduler benchmark; no live model/browser calls.

    It compares equal unit work with the dependency graph used at runtime.  The
    result is a planning check, not a claim about hosted-model latency.
    """
    durations = {"tender": 90, "specifications": 110, "erp": 100, "mail": 95, "pricing": 25, "submit": 70}
    sequential = sum(durations.values())
    discovery_done = max(durations["tender"], durations["specifications"], 30)
    # ERP and mail have safe reconnaissance before their tender/spec dependency,
    # then complete focused work after the inputs arrive.
    parallel = max(discovery_done + durations["erp"], durations["tender"] + durations["mail"]) + durations["pricing"] + durations["submit"]
    return {"sequential_seconds": sequential, "dependency_aware_parallel_seconds": parallel,
            "saved_seconds": max(0, sequential - parallel), "assumptions": durations}


@dataclass
class Specialist:
    role: str
    site_id: str
    browser: BrowserSession
    model: QwenClient
    classifier: PopupClassifier
    telemetry: Telemetry
    controller: Orchestrator


class MultiAgentCoordinator:
    def __init__(self, run, config, deadline, root_telemetry, trace_dir: Path, token=None):
        self.run, self.config, self.deadline, self.root_telemetry, self.trace_dir, self.token = run, config, deadline, root_telemetry, trace_dir, token
        self.assignments = assign_sites(run.access)
        self.ledger = EvidenceLedger(root_telemetry)
        self.specialists: dict[str, Specialist] = {}
        self.submission = None
        self.pricing = None
        self.sequential_fallback = False

    @property
    def telemetries(self):
        return [self.root_telemetry, *(item.telemetry for item in self.specialists.values())]

    async def start(self):
        if self.config.sandbox and len(self.config.cdp_urls) != 4:
            raise RuntimeError("The multi-agent runtime requires exactly four supplied CDP browsers")
        if len(self.run.access) < 4:
            raise RuntimeError("The RFQ runtime must provide four website access records")
        dispatcher = QwenClient(self.config, self.root_telemetry)
        try:
            self.assignments = await dispatcher.assign_specialists(
                self.run.brief, [{"id": site.siteId, "url": site.url} for site in self.run.access], self.assignments)
        finally:
            await dispatcher.close()
        for index, role in enumerate(ROLE_ORDER):
            site_id = self.assignments[role]
            telemetry = Telemetry(self.trace_dir / role, self.root_telemetry.redactor, run_id=self.run.run_id,
                                  console=self.root_telemetry.console, agent=role)
            telemetry.structured_stdout = self.root_telemetry.structured_stdout
            telemetry.debug = self.root_telemetry.debug
            browser = BrowserSession(self.config, self.run, telemetry, headful=True, browser_index=index,
                                     agent_id=role, assigned_site=site_id, allow_submission=role == "tender")
            await browser.start()
            model = QwenClient(self.config, telemetry)
            classifier = PopupClassifier(self.config, telemetry)
            controller = Orchestrator(self.run, self.config, browser, model, telemetry, self.deadline, self.token,
                                      ledger=self.ledger, agent_name=role, role_instruction=ROLE_INSTRUCTIONS[role],
                                      research_only=True)
            controller.popup_classifier = classifier
            self.specialists[role] = Specialist(role, site_id, browser, model, classifier, telemetry, controller)
            telemetry.emit("agent_started", role=role, assigned_site=site_id, browser_index=index,
                           remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
        tender = self.specialists["tender"]
        self.submission = Submission(self.run, tender.browser, tender.telemetry)

    async def investigate(self, steps=72, *, stop_at_submission_reserve=False):
        return await self.investigate_roles(steps=steps, stop_at_submission_reserve=stop_at_submission_reserve)

    async def investigate_roles(self, *, steps=72, roles: tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
                                stop_at_submission_reserve=False):
        """Run all specialists or a bounded evidence-only focus subset."""
        selected = tuple(roles or tuple(self.specialists))
        unknown = set(selected) - set(self.specialists)
        if unknown:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown specialist roles: {sorted(unknown)}")
        async def run_one(item: Specialist):
            item.controller.stop_at_submission_reserve = stop_at_submission_reserve
            try:
                return await item.controller.run_loop(max_steps=steps)
            except Exception as exc:
                item.telemetry.emit("agent_failed", error=safe_error(exc, item.telemetry.redactor), role=item.role)
                return False
        items = [self.specialists[role] for role in selected]
        # Do not wait for a healthy, slow worker to exhaust the signing reserve
        # after two peers have already failed.  The prior gather-only design
        # noticed that condition only when every worker had ended, which made
        # the existing bounded sequential recovery unreachable in this run.
        pending = {asyncio.create_task(run_one(item)): item.role for item in items}
        outcomes: dict[str, bool] = {}
        while pending:
            done, _ = await asyncio.wait(pending, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
            for task in done:
                role = pending.pop(task)
                outcomes[role] = task.result()
            failures_so_far = [role for role, ok in outcomes.items() if not ok]
            if roles is None and len(failures_so_far) >= 2 and not self.sequential_fallback and not self.deadline.submission_due:
                await self._sequential_recovery(failures_so_far)
        failures = [role for role in selected if not outcomes[role]]
        self.root_telemetry.emit("agents_phase_complete", completed=[role for role in selected if role not in failures],
                                 failed=failures, focus=selected, remaining=self.deadline.remaining)
        if roles is not None:
            return failures
        if len(failures) >= 2 and not self.sequential_fallback and not self.deadline.submission_due:
            await self._sequential_recovery(failures)
        return failures

    async def _sequential_recovery(self, failures: list[str]):
        """Reuse the idle tender browser before the protected signing window."""
        # Reliability wins over keeping four logical agents alive. Reuse one of
        # the supplied browsers; never create a fifth browser or retry a failed
        # worker on its own browser.
        tender = self.specialists["tender"]
        tender.browser.expand_to_run_access()
        tender.controller.role_instruction = (
            "Multiple specialists failed. Perform a bounded sequential recovery across the runtime-provided sites, "
            "using shared evidence to fill only the highest-impact missing facts. Do not submit."
        )
        self.sequential_fallback = True
        await tender.controller.run_loop(max_steps=48)
        self.root_telemetry.emit("sequential_fallback_complete", failed_agents=failures,
                                 remaining=self.deadline.remaining)

    def set_research_focus(self, role: str | None):
        if role is None:
            return
        if role not in self.specialists:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown specialist role: {role}")
        if role == "tender":
            self.specialists[role].controller.role_instruction += (

        await coordinator.start()

            except Exception as exc:

        failed = await coordinator.investigate_roles(
            steps=max(1, min(args.max_steps, 96)), roles=focus_roles,

        )
        if args.research_only:
            telemetry.artifact("summary.json", {"success": False, "research_only": True,

def compact(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()


class EvidenceLedger:
    def __init__(self, telemetry):
        self.telemetry = telemetry
        self.observations: dict[str, Observation] = {}
        self.facts: dict[str, EvidenceFact] = {}
        self.records: dict[str, dict[str, Sourced]] = defaultdict(dict)
        self.rejected: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = {}
        self.conflicts: list[dict] = []

    def reject(self, kind: str, data: dict, error: str):
        key = (kind, str(data.get("id", "missing-id")))
        self.rejected[key] = {"kind": kind, "data": data, "error": error}
        if len(self.rejected) > 50:
            self.rejected.pop(next(iter(self.rejected)))

    def observe(self, observation: Observation) -> None:
        self.observations[observation.id] = observation

    def cite(self, observation_id: str, excerpt: str, scope: dict | None = None) -> EvidenceFact:
        # A control reference unambiguously identifies its originating observation. Accept that spelling,
        # but still require the exact excerpt to exist in that observation's visible text.
        control = re.fullmatch(r"(.+)-f\d+-e\d+", observation_id)
        if control:
            observation_id = control.group(1)
        if observation_id not in self.observations:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown observation {observation_id!r}; use current_observation.id, not an element ref")
        observation = self.observations[observation_id]
        if len(compact(excerpt)) < 3 or compact(excerpt) not in compact(observation.text):
            raise ValueError("Citation must be an exact visible excerpt from the named observation")
        fact = EvidenceFact(
            id=f"e{len(self.facts) + 1}", observation_id=observation_id, website=observation.url,
            url=observation.url, title=observation.title, excerpt=excerpt, action_id=observation.action_id,
            observed_at=observation.observed_at, scope=scope or {},
        )
        self.facts[fact.id] = fact
        self.telemetry.emit("evidence_added", evidence=fact.model_dump(mode="json"))
        return fact

    def record(self, kind: str, data: dict) -> Sourced:
        if kind not in RECORD_TYPES:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown record kind: {kind}")
        record = RECORD_TYPES[kind].model_validate(data)
        missing = [ref for ref in record.evidence if ref not in self.facts]
        if missing:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown evidence references: {missing}")
        old = self.records[kind].get(record.id)
        if old and old != record:
            self.conflicts.append({"kind": kind, "id": record.id, "previous": old.model_dump(mode="json"),
                                   "replacement": record.model_dump(mode="json")})
            self.telemetry.emit("conflict_detected", kind=kind, record_id=record.id,
                                previous=old.model_dump(mode="json"), replacement=record.model_dump(mode="json"))
        self.records[kind][record.id] = record
        self.rejected.pop((kind, record.id), None)
        self.telemetry.emit("record_added", kind=kind, record=record.model_dump(mode="json"))
        return record

    def all(self, kind: str) -> list:
        return list(self.records[kind].values())

    def snapshot(self) -> dict:
        return {kind: [v.model_dump(mode="json") for v in values.values()] for kind, values in self.records.items() if values}

    def summary(self) -> dict:
        return {"records": self.snapshot(), "rejected_records": list(self.rejected.values()),
                "extraction_replacements": self.conflicts[-20:], "evidence": [
            {"id": v.id, "scope": v.scope, "excerpt": v.excerpt[:120]} for v in self.facts.values()
        ]}

def assign_sites(access) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Map runtime-provided sites to specialist roles without scenario-specific URLs.

    Runtime IDs and hosts are only hints.  If an unseen deployment gives opaque
    identifiers, assignment remains deterministic and every specialist still
    decides its own navigation from live observations.
    """
    available = list(access)
    result: dict[str, str] = {}
    for role in ROLE_ORDER:
        best = None
        best_score = 0
        for site in available:
            text = f"{site.siteId} {site.url}".lower()
            score = sum(bool(re.search(re.escape(hint), text)) for hint in ROLE_HINTS[role])
            if score > best_score:
                best, best_score = site, score
        if best is None:
            best = available[0]
        result[role] = best.siteId
        available.remove(best)
    return result


def benchmark_schedule() -> dict:
    """Deterministic scheduler benchmark; no live model/browser calls.

    It compares equal unit work with the dependency graph used at runtime.  The
    result is a planning check, not a claim about hosted-model latency.
    """
    durations = {"tender": 90, "specifications": 110, "erp": 100, "mail": 95, "pricing": 25, "submit": 70}
    sequential = sum(durations.values())
    discovery_done = max(durations["tender"], durations["specifications"], 30)
    # ERP and mail have safe reconnaissance before their tender/spec dependency,
    # then complete focused work after the inputs arrive.
    parallel = max(discovery_done + durations["erp"], durations["tender"] + durations["mail"]) + durations["pricing"] + durations["submit"]
    return {"sequential_seconds": sequential, "dependency_aware_parallel_seconds": parallel,
            "saved_seconds": max(0, sequential - parallel), "assumptions": durations}

import argparse

async def run(args):
    started = time.monotonic()
    redactor = Redactor(value for key, value in os.environ.items() if any(x in key for x in ("KEY", "TOKEN", "PASSWORD")))
    telemetry = Telemetry(Path(args.trace_dir), redactor)
    coordinator = dashboard = None
    try:
        if args.benchmark:
            telemetry.emit("architecture_benchmark", result=benchmark_schedule())
            return 0
        config = Config.from_env()
        telemetry.structured_stdout = config.sandbox
        telemetry.debug = args.debug
        context = await load_run()
        for site in context.access:
            for value in site.credentials.values():
                redactor.add(value)
        telemetry.run_id = context.run_id
        deadline = Deadline(config.budget, config.reserve, context.expires_at if config.sandbox else None, started=started)
        telemetry.emit("run_started", mode="sandbox" if config.sandbox else "scouting", provider=config.provider,
                       model=config.model, remaining=deadline.remaining)
        if args.model_smoke:
            from .models import QwenClient
            model = QwenClient(config, telemetry)
            telemetry.emit("model_smoke", result=await model.smoke())
            await model.close()
            return 0
        coordinator = MultiAgentCoordinator(context, config, deadline, telemetry, Path(args.trace_dir), os.environ.get("CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN"))
        await coordinator.start()
        coordinator.set_research_focus(args.focus)
        if args.dashboard and not config.sandbox:
            dashboard = Dashboard(coordinator.telemetries, args.dashboard_port)
            try:
                port = await dashboard.start()
                telemetry.emit("dashboard_started", url=f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}")
            except Exception as exc:
                telemetry.emit("dashboard_unavailable", error=safe_error(exc, redactor))
        focus_roles = (args.focus,) if args.focus else None
        failed = await coordinator.investigate_roles(
            steps=max(1, min(args.max_steps, 96)), roles=focus_roles,
            stop_at_submission_reserve=not args.research_only,
        )
        if args.research_only:
            telemetry.artifact("summary.json", {"success": False, "research_only": True,
                               "failed_agents": failed, "remaining": deadline.remaining,
                               "benchmark": benchmark_schedule()})
            telemetry.emit("research_complete", failed_agents=failed, remaining=deadline.remaining)
            return 0
        success = await coordinator.calculate_and_submit(steps=max(1, args.max_steps - 96))
        telemetry.artifact("summary.json", {"success": success, "failed_agents": failed,
                           "submission": coordinator.submission.state, "receipt": coordinator.submission.receipt,
                           "remaining": deadline.remaining, "benchmark": benchmark_schedule()})
        return 0 if success else 2
    except Exception as exc:
        telemetry.emit("run_failed", error=safe_error(exc, redactor))
        return 1
    finally:
        for resource in (dashboard, coordinator):
            if resource:
                try:
                    await asyncio.wait_for(resource.close(), timeout=2)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        telemetry.close()

"""Clef-assisted visual popup classification with no authority to act."""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json

from openai import AsyncOpenAI


class PopupClassifier:
    """Classify sanitized screenshots only when browser evidence suggests a blocker.

    This is deliberately advisory.  It neither sees credentials/TAN screenshots
    nor produces browser actions; Qwen still chooses every observed control.
    """
    def __init__(self, config, telemetry):
        self.telemetry = telemetry
        self.model = config.clef_model
        self.client = (AsyncOpenAI(base_url=config.clef_url, api_key=config.clef_key, max_retries=0, timeout=15)
                       if config.clef_url and config.clef_key else None)
        self.disabled_reason = None

    @staticmethod
    def verification_gate(observation) -> bool:
        """Recognize an observed verification challenge and interacting with it.
        """
        text = observation.text.casefold()
        terms = ("captcha", "i am not a robot", "i'm not a robot", "ich bin kein roboter",
                 "robot challenge", "verification challenge",
                 "zum entsperren", "ganz nach rechts", "empfangsnummer",
                 "betriebsbedingungen", "systemmitteilung", "geschützter bereich",
                 "ich bin kein", "kein roboter")
        return any(term in text for term in terms)

    @staticmethod
    def needed(observation) -> bool:
        text = observation.text.lower()
        if PopupClassifier.verification_gate(observation):
            return False
        modal = any(item.get("inside_modal") or item.get("blocked_by_modal") for item in observation.controls)
        words = ("cookie", "consent", "survey", "notice", "hinweis", "robot", "captcha", "verification", "overlay")
        return modal or any(word in text for word in words)

    async def classify(self, image_base64: str | None, observation) -> dict | None:
        if self.verification_gate(observation):
            result = {
                "kind": "verification_gate",
                "reason": ("Observed verification gate: drag unlock slider fully right, "
                           "check robot checkbox, copy Empfangsnummer into protected input, "
                           "accept Betriebsbedingungen, then Weiter"),
                "safe_next_step": "solve_observed_verification_gate",
            }
            self.telemetry.emit("popup_classified", observation=observation.id, classification=result)
            return result
        if not self.client or not image_base64 or not self.needed(observation):
            return None
        prompt = (
            "Classify this sanitized browser screenshot for a sales-RFQ agent. Return JSON only: "
            '{"kind":"blocking_popup|normal_page|uncertain","reason":"short visible-only description",'
            '"safe_next_step":"inspect_observed_popup_control|continue_normal_observation"}. '
            "Do not identify values, infer hidden controls, or propose coordinates."
        )
        try:
            async with asyncio.timeout(15):
                response = await self.client.chat.completions.create(
                    model=self.model,
                    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [
                        {"type": "text", "text": prompt},
                        {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/png;base64," + image_base64}},
                    ]}], max_tokens=180, temperature=0,
                )
            text = (response.choices[0].message.content or "").strip().removeprefix("```json").removesuffix("```").strip()
            result = json.loads(text)
            if result.get("kind") not in {"blocking_popup", "normal_page", "uncertain"}:
                raise ValueError("unexpected classification")
            result = {key: str(result.get(key, ""))[:280] for key in ("kind", "reason", "safe_next_step")}
            self.telemetry.emit("popup_classified", observation=observation.id, classification=result)
            return result
        except Exception as exc:
            # Do not log response bodies, endpoint URLs, headers, or request
            # payloads: those can contain credentials or image-derived data.
            self.telemetry.emit("popup_classification_unavailable", error=type(exc).__name__,
                                status=getattr(exc, "status_code", None))
            # A permanent endpoint mismatch cannot become useful on a later
            # screenshot. Keep Clef advisory and stop spending calls while the
            # DOM-based modal controls remain available to Qwen.
            if getattr(exc, "status_code", None) in {401, 403, 404, 422}:
                self.disabled_reason = f"HTTP {getattr(exc, 'status_code')}"
                await self.client.close()
                self.client = None
                self.telemetry.emit("popup_classifier_disabled", reason=self.disabled_reason)
            return None

    async def close(self):
        if self.client:
            await self.client.close()
        # An image from an earlier observation must never ground a new pixel action.
        self.last_image = None
        self.last_image_size = None
        await self._recover_persistent_blank_page()
        self.observation_number += 1
        oid = f"{self.agent_id + '-' if self.agent_id else ''}o{self.observation_number}"
        self.refs = {}
        controls, frames, texts = [], [], []
        if not self.dialogs:
            for frame_index, frame in enumerate(self.page.frames):
                frames.append({"frame": frame_index, "url": frame.url, "name": frame.name})
                try:
                    body = await frame.locator("body").inner_text(timeout=2000)
                    texts.append(f"[frame {frame_index}]\n{body}")
                    # Canvas-rendered gates and diagrams can expose their only
                    # readable description through accessibility metadata.
                    semantics = await frame.locator("canvas[aria-label],[role=img][aria-label]").evaluate_all(
                        "els => els.slice(0, 20).map(e => e.getAttribute('aria-label')).filter(Boolean)")
                    if semantics:
                        texts.append("[accessible visual descriptions]\n" + "\n".join(map(str, semantics)))
                    elements = await frame.query_selector_all(CONTROL_SELECTOR)
                    for index, element in enumerate(elements[:350]):
                        info = await element.evaluate(CONTROL_INFO)
                        if info is None:
                            continue
                        ref = f"{oid}-f{frame_index}-e{index}"
                        self.refs[ref] = element
                        info.update({"ref": ref, "frame": frame_index})
                        info["label"] = str(info["label"])[:250]
                        controls.append(info)
                except Exception as exc:
                    texts.append(f"[frame {frame_index} unavailable: {type(exc).__name__}]")
        raw = "\n".join(texts)
        for match in TAN_PATTERN.finditer(raw):
            self.telemetry.redactor.add(match.group(1))
        self.raw_text[oid] = raw
        if len(self.raw_text) > 20:
            self.raw_text.pop(next(iter(self.raw_text)))
        dialog = {"type": self.dialogs[0].type, "message": self.dialogs[0].message} if self.dialogs else None
        text = self.telemetry.redactor.text(raw[:36000])
        if dialog:
            text += "\n[Browser dialog] " + self.telemetry.redactor.text(dialog["message"])
        obs = Observation(id=oid, action_id=self.telemetry.action_id, tab=self.tab,
                          url=self.telemetry.redactor.text(self.page.url), title=await self.page.title() if not dialog else "Dialog open",
                          text=text, controls=self.telemetry.redactor.clean(controls), frames=self.telemetry.redactor.clean(frames),
                          tabs=[{"tab": i, "url": self.telemetry.redactor.text(p.url)} for i, p in enumerate(self.pages) if not p.is_closed()],
                          dialog=self.telemetry.redactor.clean(dialog), documents=[{"id": k, "name": v["name"]} for k, v in self.downloads.items()])
        self.last_observation = obs
        self.telemetry.tab = self.tab
        self.telemetry.site = urlsplit(self.page.url).hostname or ""
        self.telemetry.emit("observation", id=oid, url=obs.url, title=obs.title, text=text, controls=obs.controls,
                            frames=obs.frames, tabs=obs.tabs, dialog=obs.dialog, documents=obs.documents)
        if not dialog and (include_image or time.monotonic() - self.last_screenshot >= 4):
            await self.screenshot(raw)
        return obs

    async def screenshot(self, raw=None):
        raw = raw if raw is not None else "\n".join(self.raw_text.values())
        self.last_image = None
        # Mask matching text in every frame; omit the image if a secret cannot be located reliably.

                self.telemetry.emit("popup_classifier_disabled", reason=self.disabled_reason)
            return None

    async def close(self):
        if self.client:
            await self.client.close()
        # An image from an earlier observation must never ground a new pixel action.
        self.last_image = None
        self.last_image_size = None
        await self._recover_persistent_blank_page()
        self.observation_number += 1
        oid = f"{self.agent_id + '-' if self.agent_id else ''}o{self.observation_number}"
        self.refs = {}
        controls, frames, texts = [], [], []
        if not self.dialogs:
            for frame_index, frame in enumerate(self.page.frames):
                frames.append({"frame": frame_index, "url": frame.url, "name": frame.name})
                try:
                    body = await frame.locator("body").inner_text(timeout=2000)
                    texts.append(f"[frame {frame_index}]\n{body}")
                    # Canvas-rendered gates and diagrams can expose their only
                    # readable description through accessibility metadata.
                    semantics = await frame.locator("canvas[aria-label],[role=img][aria-label]").evaluate_all(
                        "els => els.slice(0, 20).map(e => e.getAttribute('aria-label')).filter(Boolean)")
                    if semantics:
                        texts.append("[accessible visual descriptions]\n" + "\n".join(map(str, semantics)))
                    elements = await frame.query_selector_all(CONTROL_SELECTOR)
                    for index, element in enumerate(elements[:350]):
                        info = await element.evaluate(CONTROL_INFO)
                        if info is None:
                            continue
                        ref = f"{oid}-f{frame_index}-e{index}"
                        self.refs[ref] = element
                        info.update({"ref": ref, "frame": frame_index})
                        info["label"] = str(info["label"])[:250]
                        controls.append(info)
                except Exception as exc:

        if len(self.raw_text) > 20:
            self.raw_text.pop(next(iter(self.raw_text)))
        dialog = {"type": self.dialogs[0].type, "message": self.dialogs[0].message} if self.dialogs else None
        text = self.telemetry.redactor.text(raw[:36000])
        if dialog:
            text += "\n[Browser dialog] " + self.telemetry.redactor.text(dialog["message"])
        obs = Observation(id=oid, action_id=self.telemetry.action_id, tab=self.tab,
