from decimal import Decimal
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock

import pytest

from atira_agent.contracts import Observation, PricingResult, RunContext, SubmissionState
from atira_agent.submit import Submission, validate_answer


def context():
    return RunContext(challenge_id="rfq", brief="fixture", access=[],
                      submission={"kind": "site", "url": "http://synthetic.test"}, answer_schema={})


def answer():
    return {"tender_reference": "SYN-R", "decision": "bid", "currency": "EUR", "discount_percent": 0,
            "positions": [{"position": "A", "material_number": "SYN-M", "quantity": 3,
                           "unit_price": Decimal("1.01"), "lead_time_weeks": 2}], "total_net": Decimal("3.03")}


def test_exact_decimal_serialization_and_total():
    assert b'1.01' in validate_answer(answer(), {})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Total"):
        validate_answer(answer() | {"total_net": Decimal("3.02")}, {})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Duplicate"):
        data = answer()
        data["positions"] *= 2
        validate_answer(data, {})


def test_actual_schema_dialect_is_honored():
    import jsonschema
    schema = {"$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#", "type": "object",
              "dependencies": {"currency": ["required_by_runtime_schema"]}}
    with pytest.raises(jsonschema.ValidationError):
        validate_answer(answer(), schema)
    with pytest.raises(jsonschema.SchemaError):
        validate_answer(answer(), {"type": "not-a-json-type"})


async def test_tan_replacement_invalidates_previous(telemetry):
    browser = MagicMock(act=AsyncMock(), latest_tan="old", tan_captured_at=1, observation_number=8)
    submission = Submission(context(), browser, telemetry)
    submission.prepare(PricingResult(answer=answer()))
    await submission.request_tan({"ref": "observed"})
    assert browser.latest_tan is None and browser.tan_captured_at is None
    assert browser.tan_request_observation == 8
    assert submission.state == SubmissionState.TAN_REQUESTED


async def test_uncertain_signing_stays_attempted(telemetry):
    import time
    browser = MagicMock(act=AsyncMock(side_effect=TimeoutError("uncertain click")),
                        latest_tan="synthetic", tan_captured_at=time.monotonic())
    submission = Submission(context(), browser, telemetry)
    submission.prepare(PricingResult(answer=answer()))
    submission.state = SubmissionState.TAN_REQUESTED
    with pytest.raises(TimeoutError):
        await submission.sign({"ref": "button", "reviewed": True, "omissions_confirmed": True})
    assert submission.state == SubmissionState.SIGNING_ATTEMPTED
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        await submission.sign({"ref": "button", "reviewed": True, "omissions_confirmed": True})


def test_draft_or_wrong_tender_is_not_receipt(telemetry):
    submission = Submission(context(), MagicMock(), telemetry)
    submission.prepare(PricingResult(answer=answer()))
    obs = Observation(id="o1", action_id=1, tab=0, url="http://synthetic.test", title="receipt",
                      text="OTHER-TENDER received confirmation C-1")
    args = {"receipt_id": "C-1", "excerpt": "received confirmation C-1"}
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="No signing"):
        submission.accept_receipt(obs, args)
    submission.state = SubmissionState.SIGNING_ATTEMPTED
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="identify"):
        submission.accept_receipt(obs, args)


async def test_site_submission_cannot_use_api(telemetry):
    submission = Submission(context(), MagicMock(), telemetry)
    submission.prepare(PricingResult(answer=answer()))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="website"):
        await submission.api_submit("synthetic-token")


async def test_receipt_requires_fresh_portal_observation_and_uncertain_retry_is_blocked(telemetry):
    import time
    from datetime import timedelta
    browser = MagicMock(act=AsyncMock(), latest_tan="synthetic", tan_captured_at=time.monotonic())
    submission = Submission(context(), browser, telemetry)
    submission.prepare(PricingResult(answer=answer()))
    old = Observation(id="o1", action_id=1, tab=0, url="http://synthetic.test", title="Receipt",
                      text="SYN-R accepted receipt C-1")
    submission.state = SubmissionState.TAN_REQUESTED
    await submission.sign({"ref": "send", "reviewed": True, "omissions_confirmed": True})
    args = {"receipt_id": "C-1", "excerpt": "accepted receipt C-1"}
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="predates"):
        submission.accept_receipt(old, args)
    foreign = Observation(id="o2", action_id=2, tab=0, url="http://mail.test", title="Forwarded receipt", text=old.text)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="declared submission"):
        submission.accept_receipt(foreign, args)
    browser.last_observation = old
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Inspect the portal"):
        await submission.request_tan({"ref": "request"})
    browser.last_observation = Observation(id="o3", action_id=3, tab=0, url="http://synthetic.test", title="Error",
                                           text="SYN-R: TAN invalid", observed_at=submission.signing_started_at + timedelta(seconds=1))
    await submission.request_tan({"ref": "request"})
    assert submission.state == SubmissionState.TAN_REQUESTED
    assert browser.latest_tan is None

import pytest

from atira_agent.config import Config

    action = parse_action(json.dumps({"action": "navigate", "url": "https://synthetic.test"}))
    assert action.args == {"url": "https://synthetic.test"}
    assert action.summary == "Execute navigate"

@pytest.mark.parametrize("args", [{}, {"kind": "qa"}, {"records": []}])

I turned the 35.2-score feedback into targeted improvements.

- Prioritized full tender coverage: all positions, current requirements, withdrawn Q&A, and per-position metal-index rules before optional browsing.
- Increased discovery allowance from 48 to 60 turns per specialist and made recovery cover every relevant role concurrently.
- Added a mandatory `review_submission` gate before signing. It checks the visible portal draft against deterministic values and blocks signing on mismatched material, quantity, price, lead time, or total.
- This specifically addresses the 01.02 mismatch: logs calculated `HZ-2170`, while the accepted portal bid contained `HZ-9275`.
- Fixed a history-compaction regression that could hide citation IDs between model turns.

Admin API Keys

Admin API keys enable Organization Owners to programmatically manage various aspects of their organization, including users, projects, and API keys. These keys provide administrative capabilities, such as creating, updating, and deleting users; managing projects; and overseeing API key lifecycles.

Key Features of Admin API Keys:

  * User Management: Invite new users, update roles, and remove users from the organization.

  * Project Management: Create, update, archive projects, and manage user assignments within projects.

  * API Key Oversight: List, retrieve, and delete API keys associated with projects.

Only Organization Owners have the authority to create and utilize Admin API keys. To manage these keys, Organization Owners can navigate to the Admin Keys section of their API Platform dashboard.

For direct access to the Admin Keys management page, Organization Owners can use the following link:

https://platform.openai.com/settings/organization/admin-keys

It's crucial to handle Admin API keys with care due to their elevated permissions. Adhering to best practices, such as regular key rotation and assigning appropriate permissions, enhances security and ensures proper governance within the organization.

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Config:
    sandbox: bool
    cdp_urls: tuple[str, ...]
    provider: str
    model: str
    model_url: str
    model_key: str
    budget: float = 1200
    reserve: float = 180
    clef_url: str | None = None
    clef_key: str | None = None
    clef_model: str = "clef"

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls, env=None) -> "Config":
        env = os.environ if env is None else env
        sandbox = bool(env.get("CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN"))
        raw = env.get("CDP_URLS")
        if raw:
            urls = json.loads(raw)
            if not isinstance(urls, list) or not urls or not all(isinstance(x, str) for x in urls):
                raise ValueError("CDP_URLS must be a nonempty JSON array of URLs")
        else:
            urls = [env["CDP_URL"]] if env.get("CDP_URL") else []
        if sandbox and not urls:
            raise ValueError("Sandbox requires a supplied CDP connection; launching Chromium is forbidden")
        if len(urls) > 4:
            raise ValueError("Atira provides at most four browsers")
        for url in urls:
            parsed = urlsplit(url)
            if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https", "ws", "wss"} or parsed.hostname not in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"}:
                raise ValueError("CDP must connect to a supplied local browser")
        provider = env.get("ATIRA_MODEL_PROVIDER", "qwen")
        if provider not in {"qwen", "openai"}:
            raise ValueError("Supported providers: qwen, openai")
        if provider != "qwen" and env.get("ATIRA_ALLOW_PAID") != "1":
            raise ValueError("Paid provider disabled; explicit ATIRA_ALLOW_PAID=1 is required")
        prefix = provider.upper()
        base, key = env.get(f"{prefix}_BASE_URL", ""), env.get(f"{prefix}_API_KEY", "")
        if not base or not key:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing {prefix}_BASE_URL/{prefix}_API_KEY. Start atira models proxy and load scout --env")
        parsed = urlsplit(base)
        if not parsed.hostname or parsed.username or parsed.password:
            raise ValueError("Invalid model proxy URL")
        if sandbox:
            proxy = env.get("LLM_PROXY_URL", "").rstrip("/")
            if not proxy or not base.startswith(proxy + "/"):
                raise ValueError("Model endpoint must be inside the supplied Atira run proxy")
        elif parsed.hostname not in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"}:
            raise ValueError("Local mode uses the Atira localhost model proxy")
        model = env.get("ATIRA_MODEL", "qwen" if provider == "qwen" else "")
        if not model:
            raise ValueError("A paid provider requires an explicit ATIRA_MODEL")
        budget = min(1200, float(env.get("ATIRA_BUDGET_SECONDS", 1200)))
        reserve = float(env.get("ATIRA_SUBMISSION_RESERVE", 180))
        if budget <= 0 or not 0 < reserve < budget:
            raise ValueError("Require 0 < submission reserve < budget <= 1200 seconds")
        clef_url, clef_key = env.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"), env.get("CLEF_API_KEY")
        if bool(clef_url) != bool(clef_key):
            raise ValueError("CLEF_BASE_URL and CLEF_API_KEY must be supplied together")
        if clef_url:
            clef = urlsplit(clef_url)
            if not clef.hostname or clef.username or clef.password:
                raise ValueError("Invalid Clef proxy URL")
            if sandbox:
                proxy = env.get("LLM_PROXY_URL", "").rstrip("/")
                if not proxy or not clef_url.startswith(proxy + "/"):
                    raise ValueError("Clef endpoint must be inside the supplied Atira run proxy")
            elif clef.hostname not in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"}:
                raise ValueError("Local mode uses the Atira localhost Clef proxy")
        return cls(sandbox, tuple(urls), provider, model, base, key, budget, reserve, clef_url, clef_key,
                   env.get("ATIRA_CLEF_MODEL", "clef"))

# Atira RFQ agent

An independent Python 3.12 implementation on the existing orphan branch. Qwen chooses browser actions and
documents from observations; typed evidence feeds deterministic EUR pricing; the browser enters and signs the bid.
A signed scouting acknowledgment is different from an accepted sandbox answer.

## Windows quickstart

From this directory, in PowerShell:

```powershell
uv python install 3.12
uv sync --frozen
uv run playwright install chromium
# This machine already has Atira installed; expose it in this terminal if necessary:
$env:PATH = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\atira\bin;$env:PATH"
atira whoami
# Only if not already authenticated:
atira login
```

On a new computer, the official Windows CLI installer is:

```powershell
irm https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/install.ps1 | iex
```

Terminal 1 (leave running):

```powershell
atira models proxy
```

Terminal 2, from the project directory:

```powershell
atira scout --env | Out-String | Invoke-Expression
uv run python agent.py --model-smoke
.\scripts\run-local.ps1
# Evidence-only scouting: never calculate, request a TAN, or submit.
.\scripts\run-local.ps1 -ResearchOnly -MaxSteps 180
# One specialist only, for a bounded evidence investigation.
.\scripts\run-local.ps1 -ResearchOnly -Focus tender -MaxSteps 180
```

Watch the visible Chromium window and [local dashboard](http://127.0.0.1:8787).
The launcher also resolves the existing CLI under `%LOCALAPPDATA%` when it is absent from PATH.
It does not print scouting credentials. Traces are written beneath ignored `artifacts/` directories.

```powershell
uv run python scripts/inspect-trace.py artifacts/<session-directory>
.\scripts\test-local.ps1 -Browser
uv run python scripts/package_check.py
atira test-run . --challenge rfq --dry-run
atira test-run . --challenge rfq
atira status <run-id> --json
atira logs <run-id> --follow
```

The last command that starts a run above is **unscored**. No script executes `atira submit`, pushes Git branches,
changes team settings, or enables a paid model. A scored submission requires the user's separate approval.

## Runtime

`agent.json` installs the frozen runtime dependencies and runs `agent.py`. The sandbox connects exclusively to four
supplied CDP Chromium instances, never launches another browser, and reads the task/schema/fresh credentials from the
current-run API. A browserless coordinator assigns one runtime site to each tender, specifications, ERP and mail
specialist. Local mode requires `CHALLENGE_SCOUTING` and launches four visible Chromium instances. Site addresses and
+tender values are never compiled into application code. Each browser's request filter permits only its assigned runtime
+origin (the tender browser also accesses the declared submission origin).

Qwen uses `QWEN_BASE_URL` and `QWEN_API_KEY` from Atira. No personal OpenAI key is needed. Optional OpenAI-compatible
paid-provider configuration requires both `ATIRA_MODEL_PROVIDER=openai` and `ATIRA_ALLOW_PAID=1`, an explicit model,
and an Atira proxy endpoint. Do not enable it without approval. Merely having a key does not activate paid inference.

When Atira supplies `CLEF_BASE_URL` and `CLEF_API_KEY`, Clef classifies only sanitized screenshots that look like a
blocking popup.

Configuration: `ATIRA_BUDGET_SECONDS` (maximum 1200), `ATIRA_SUBMISSION_RESERVE` (default 180),
`ATIRA_DASHBOARD_PORT` (default 8787). Sandbox platform expiry is an additional hard bound. Local scouting credential
expiry is not the run timer. `--max-steps` limits debugging rehearsals; use the default for a full run.

## Implementation and evidence

- `src/atira_agent/multi_agent.py`: dependency-aware four-specialist scheduling, shared evidence, TAN handoff and benchmark.
- `src/atira_agent/orchestrator.py`: observation-conditioned specialist actions and bounded failure recovery.
- `src/atira_agent/business_rules.py` and `pricing.py`: dated scope, exact matches, Decimal calculations and allocations.
- `src/atira_agent/browser.py` and `submit.py`: generic visible browser operations, TAN and receipt states.
- `src/atira_agent/telemetry.py` and `dashboard.py`: redacted durable events and a nonblocking local viewer.

See [architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [official contract](docs/ATIRA_CONTRACT.md),
[debugging](docs/DEBUGGING.md), [Windows runbook](docs/RUNBOOK_WINDOWS.md), and [known gaps](docs/KNOWN_GAPS.md).
The [rehearsal report](docs/REHEARSAL_REPORT.md) records actual commands, tests, run IDs, results and artifacts.
Passing unit tests is not a live signed bid.

Run the offline architecture comparison without credentials or browser startup:

```powershell
uv run python agent.py --benchmark
```

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Config:
    sandbox: bool
    cdp_urls: tuple[str, ...]
    provider: str
    model: str
    model_url: str
    model_key: str
    budget: float = 1200
    reserve: float = 180
    clef_url: str | None = None
    clef_key: str | None = None
    clef_model: str = "clef"

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls, env=None) -> "Config":
        env = os.environ if env is None else env
        sandbox = bool(env.get("CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN"))
        raw = env.get("CDP_URLS")
        if raw:
            urls = json.loads(raw)
            if not isinstance(urls, list) or not urls or not all(isinstance(x, str) for x in urls):
                raise ValueError("CDP_URLS must be a nonempty JSON array of URLs")
        else:
            urls = [env["CDP_URL"]] if env.get("CDP_URL") else []
        if sandbox and not urls:
            raise ValueError("Sandbox requires a supplied CDP connection; launching Chromium is forbidden")
        if len(urls) > 4:
            raise ValueError("Atira provides at most four browsers")
        for url in urls:
            parsed = urlsplit(url)
            if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https", "ws", "wss"} or parsed.hostname not in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"}:
                raise ValueError("CDP must connect to a supplied local browser")
        provider = env.get("ATIRA_MODEL_PROVIDER", "qwen")
        if provider not in {"qwen", "openai"}:
            raise ValueError("Supported providers: qwen, openai")
        if provider != "qwen" and env.get("ATIRA_ALLOW_PAID") != "1":
            raise ValueError("Paid provider disabled; explicit ATIRA_ALLOW_PAID=1 is required")
        prefix = provider.upper()
        base, key = env.get(f"{prefix}_BASE_URL", ""), env.get(f"{prefix}_API_KEY", "")
        if not base or not key:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing {prefix}_BASE_URL/{prefix}_API_KEY. Start atira models proxy and load scout --env")
        parsed = urlsplit(base)
        if not parsed.hostname or parsed.username or parsed.password:
            raise ValueError("Invalid model proxy URL")
        if sandbox:
            proxy = env.get("LLM_PROXY_URL", "").rstrip("/")
            if not proxy or not base.startswith(proxy + "/"):
                raise ValueError("Model endpoint must be inside the supplied Atira run proxy")
        elif parsed.hostname not in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"}:
            raise ValueError("Local mode uses the Atira localhost model proxy")
        model = env.get("ATIRA_MODEL", "qwen" if provider == "qwen" else "")
        if not model:
            raise ValueError("A paid provider requires an explicit ATIRA_MODEL")
        budget = min(1200, float(env.get("ATIRA_BUDGET_SECONDS", 1200)))
        reserve = float(env.get("ATIRA_SUBMISSION_RESERVE", 180))
        if budget <= 0 or not 0 < reserve < budget:
            raise ValueError("Require 0 < submission reserve < budget <= 1200 seconds")
        clef_url, clef_key = env.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"), env.get("CLEF_API_KEY")
        if bool(clef_url) != bool(clef_key):
            raise ValueError("CLEF_BASE_URL and CLEF_API_KEY must be supplied together")
        if clef_url:
            clef = urlsplit(clef_url)
            if not clef.hostname or clef.username or clef.password:
                raise ValueError("Invalid Clef proxy URL")
            if sandbox:
                proxy = env.get("LLM_PROXY_URL", "").rstrip("/")
                if not proxy or not clef_url.startswith(proxy + "/"):
                    raise ValueError("Clef endpoint must be inside the supplied Atira run proxy")
            elif clef.hostname not in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"}:
                raise ValueError("Local mode uses the Atira localhost Clef proxy")
        return cls(sandbox, tuple(urls), provider, model, base, key, budget, reserve, clef_url, clef_key,
                   env.get("ATIRA_CLEF_MODEL", "clef"))

# Atira RFQ agent

An independent Python 3.12 implementation on the existing orphan branch. Qwen chooses browser actions and
documents from observations; typed evidence feeds deterministic EUR pricing; the browser enters and signs the bid.
A signed scouting acknowledgment is different from an accepted sandbox answer.

## Windows quickstart

From this directory, in PowerShell:

```powershell
uv python install 3.12
uv sync --frozen
uv run playwright install chromium
# This machine already has Atira installed; expose it in this terminal if necessary:
$env:PATH = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\atira\bin;$env:PATH"
atira whoami
# Only if not already authenticated:
atira login
```

On a new computer, the official Windows CLI installer is:

```powershell
irm https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/install.ps1 | iex
```

Terminal 1 (leave running):

```powershell
atira models proxy
```

Terminal 2, from the project directory:

```powershell
atira scout --env | Out-String | Invoke-Expression
uv run python agent.py --model-smoke
.\scripts\run-local.ps1
# Evidence-only scouting: never calculate, request a TAN, or submit.
.\scripts\run-local.ps1 -ResearchOnly -MaxSteps 180
# One specialist only, for a bounded evidence investigation.
.\scripts\run-local.ps1 -ResearchOnly -Focus tender -MaxSteps 180
```

Watch the visible Chromium window and [local dashboard](http://127.0.0.1:8787).
The launcher also resolves the existing CLI under `%LOCALAPPDATA%` when it is absent from PATH.
It does not print scouting credentials. Traces are written beneath ignored `artifacts/` directories.

```powershell
uv run python scripts/inspect-trace.py artifacts/<session-directory>
.\scripts\test-local.ps1 -Browser
uv run python scripts/package_check.py
atira test-run . --challenge rfq --dry-run
atira test-run . --challenge rfq
atira status <run-id> --json
atira logs <run-id> --follow
```

The last command that starts a run above is **unscored**. No script executes `atira submit`, pushes Git branches,
changes team settings, or enables a paid model. A scored submission requires the user's separate approval.

## Runtime

`agent.json` installs the frozen runtime dependencies and runs `agent.py`. The sandbox connects exclusively to four
supplied CDP Chromium instances, never launches another browser, and reads the task/schema/fresh credentials from the
current-run API. A browserless coordinator assigns one runtime site to each tender, specifications, ERP and mail
specialist. Local mode requires `CHALLENGE_SCOUTING` and launches four visible Chromium instances. Site addresses and
+tender values are never compiled into application code. Each browser's request filter permits only its assigned runtime
+origin (the tender browser also accesses the declared submission origin).

Qwen uses `QWEN_BASE_URL` and `QWEN_API_KEY` from Atira. No personal OpenAI key is needed. Optional OpenAI-compatible
paid-provider configuration requires both `ATIRA_MODEL_PROVIDER=openai` and `ATIRA_ALLOW_PAID=1`, an explicit model,
and an Atira proxy endpoint. Do not enable it without approval. Merely having a key does not activate paid inference.

When Atira supplies `CLEF_BASE_URL` and `CLEF_API_KEY`, Clef classifies only sanitized screenshots that look like a
blocking popup.

Configuration: `ATIRA_BUDGET_SECONDS` (maximum 1200), `ATIRA_SUBMISSION_RESERVE` (default 180),
`ATIRA_DASHBOARD_PORT` (default 8787). Sandbox platform expiry is an additional hard bound. Local scouting credential
expiry is not the run timer. `--max-steps` limits debugging rehearsals; use the default for a full run.

## Implementation and evidence

- `src/atira_agent/multi_agent.py`: dependency-aware four-specialist scheduling, shared evidence, TAN handoff and benchmark.
- `src/atira_agent/orchestrator.py`: observation-conditioned specialist actions and bounded failure recovery.
- `src/atira_agent/business_rules.py` and `pricing.py`: dated scope, exact matches, Decimal calculations and allocations.
- `src/atira_agent/browser.py` and `submit.py`: generic visible browser operations, TAN and receipt states.
- `src/atira_agent/telemetry.py` and `dashboard.py`: redacted durable events and a nonblocking local viewer.

See [architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [official contract](docs/ATIRA_CONTRACT.md),
[debugging](docs/DEBUGGING.md), [Windows runbook](docs/RUNBOOK_WINDOWS.md), and [known gaps](docs/KNOWN_GAPS.md).
The [rehearsal report](docs/REHEARSAL_REPORT.md) records actual commands, tests, run IDs, results and artifacts.
Passing unit tests is not a live signed bid.

Run the offline architecture comparison without credentials or browser startup:

```powershell
uv run python agent.py --benchmark
```

Hybrid search sends a query embedding to OpenAI and passes an external vector to Typesense. Indexing and query embeddings share the SQLite cache when `ENABLE_CACHE=true`; identical texts within a batch are sent once. Embedding requests run in bounded concurrent batches with timeout and transient error retries.

main:README.md:160:Run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q`. Unit tests require no credentials or running services. They use mocked API responses and local model objects. Live OpenAI, Docling model weights, and Typesense were not exercised in this environment. The Docling adapter preserves ordered sections, table rows, and page references when Docling exposes them; merged-cell semantics and coordinates are not yet retained. The GLiNER integration supports entities and repeated flat records with spans; arbitrary nested structures remain unsupported. Raw model scores are kept separately from deterministic validation and should not be interpreted as calibrated probabilities. The API uses a local upload directory and has no authentication, so it is intended for trusted local use. The scheduler persists JSON-serializable payloads, status, and results. HTTP submissions use an idempotency key and retries, but exact-once delivery depends on the receiving API honoring that key. Cost estimation needs task-specific pricing; accuracy evaluation needs labeled challenge data.

main:README.md:32:Set `OPENAI_API_KEY` in `.env`, then load it in your shell with `set -a; source .env; set +a`. Keep `.env` private. The default extraction path sends source documents to OpenAI. The parser and extraction model are configurable with `OPENAI_PARSER_MODEL` and `OPENAI_EXTRACTION_MODEL`. Confirm your account has access to the chosen model.
main:README.md:36:**A. Document to JSON, one OpenAI request**
main:README.md:46:Parsing and extraction results are cached in `SQLITE_PATH` by content hash, backend/model, parser options, schema, instructions, and cache version. Set `ENABLE_CACHE=false` to disable this behavior. A cached OpenAI result can be read without an API key; a cache miss still needs the key.
main:README.md:55:The first run downloads Docling and GLiNER model weights. Use a prepopulated local model cache when running without network access. GLiNER's entity mode works on string and string-list fields. For repeated flat records, call `GLiNERExtractionBackend.extract_records(parsed_document, RecordModel, "product")`; it uses GLiNER's record API, validates each record with Pydantic, and retains source spans. Arbitrarily nested RFQ structures still need another extractor. The offline path never calls OpenAI.
main:README.md:57:`--backend auto` selects GLiNER only when a local parser is selected, GLiNER is installed, and every schema field is a supported entity field. Otherwise it selects OpenAI extraction. Use explicit `--backend gliner` for documents that must remain local; `auto` can send parsed text to OpenAI.
main:README.md:90:OpenAI extraction records input and output token counts, and embeddings record token usage. `estimate_cost_usd` calculates a cost from those measured counts and rates you supply for the current model; no prices are hardcoded.
main:README.md:92:With an OpenAI key and local GLiNER weights installed, run `hackkit benchmark-backends --count 20 --format markdown` to measure both extraction backends on the synthetic starter set. This is a live comparison and incurs OpenAI API usage.
main:README.md:105:Indexing uses OpenAI `text-embedding-3-small`, default 1536 dimensions. Query embeddings must use the same model and dimensions. Change `TYPESENSE_COLLECTION` and reindex if the model or dimensions change. Keyword search needs no embedding request. Hybrid search sends a query embedding to OpenAI and passes an external vector to Typesense. Indexing and query embeddings share the SQLite cache when `ENABLE_CACHE=true`; identical texts within a batch are sent once. Embedding requests run in bounded concurrent batches with timeout and transient error retries.

main:README.md:160:Run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q`. Unit tests require no credentials or running services. They use mocked API responses and local model objects. Live OpenAI, Docling model weights, and Typesense were not exercised in this environment. The Docling adapter preserves ordered sections, table rows, and page references when Docling exposes them; merged-cell semantics and coordinates are not yet retained. The GLiNER integration supports entities and repeated flat records with spans; arbitrary nested structures remain unsupported. Raw model scores are kept separately from deterministic validation and should not be interpreted as calibrated probabilities. The API uses a local upload directory and has no authentication, so it is intended for trusted local use. The scheduler persists JSON-serializable payloads, status, and results. HTTP submissions use an idempotency key and retries, but exact-once delivery depends on the receiving API honoring that key. Cost estimation needs task-specific pricing; accuracy evaluation needs labeled challenge data.
main:README.md:162:The OpenAI file path follows the [official file-input guide](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/file-inputs), and the Pydantic extraction path follows [Structured Outputs](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/structured-outputs). GLiNER calls follow the project's [entity](https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/blob/main/tutorial/2-ner.md) and [record](https://github.com/fastino-ai/GLiNER2/blob/main/tutorial/3-json_extraction.md) tutorials. Hybrid search follows the [Typesense vector-search guide](https://typesense.org/docs/30.2/api/vector-search.html).

"""Client for the challenge-hosted Qwen model; calls go through Atira's proxy."""

import os

from openai import AsyncOpenAI

QWEN_MODEL = "qwen3.8-flash-next"


def client() -> AsyncOpenAI:
    return AsyncOpenAI(
        base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"],
        api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"],
        timeout=360,
    )


async def complete(messages: list[dict], timeout: float = 360) -> str:
    async with client() as api:
        request = api.with_options(timeout=timeout, max_retries=0)
        response = await request.chat.completions.create(model=QWEN_MODEL, messages=messages)
    return response.choices[0].message.content or ""

content.text:
This project is an EHL/Atira RFQ challenge agent. It must investigate four supplied business websites, gather citation-backed evidence, calculate a deterministic EUR offer, submit it through the tender portal, retrieve an email TAN when required, and verify the receipt within a 20-minute run.

The package is under `src/atira_agent/`:

- `runtime.py` / `config.py`: load Atira runtime data, enforce sandbox CDP-only browsers, choose Qwen through Atira’s proxy.
- `multi_agent.py`: browserless coordinator plus four model-directed specialists, each assigned one provided browser:
  - Tender: RFQ reference, positions, Q&A, amendments, submission portal.
  - Specifications: drawings, revisions, requirements, certifications.
  - ERP: exact material matches, stock, price, delivery, commercial conditions.
  - Mail: approvals, condition rules, superseded mail, TAN retrieval.
- `browser.py`: safe CDP browser tools, observations, semantic control references, frames/tabs/documents, modal detection.
